constraints: Sets the OK variable to 1 if command is a valid, existing command number, and to 0 otherwise.
Some disabled-but-still-numbered commands return an empty string for the name even though OK is set to 1.

overloadMerges.note: The parameter table marks info and theme with a '<-' (output) arrow: they are optional by-reference parameters that Command name fills in with the command's property bit-field and language theme name, not values the caller supplies. Draft autoparse had defaulted both to direction 'in'.

params.name: info
params.description: Filled in with a bit field describing the command: bit 0 = thread-safe, bit 1 = deprecated.

params.name: theme
params.description: Filled in with the name of the 4D language theme the command belongs to.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the (localized) name of the command numbered command, and optionally fills in info (thread-safe/deprecated bit field) and theme (language theme name) by reference.
